EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the graduate programs within the Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry at Arizona State University. We are not admitting students to the MS degree programs at this time, but I encourage you to consider applying for one of the PhD programs if you are interested. More information is available on our prospective student page.
The department offers PhD degrees in both chemistry and biochemistry, and all admitted students are fully funded, including the cost of tuition, health insurance and a competitive stipend..
Applications are currently being accepted for study beginning fall 2015. The application deadline is Jan. 15, 2015. We will not be admitting students for spring 2015.
Applying is a two-part process consisting of a general graduate application through the graduate admissions office and a supplemental application to the Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry. More detailed information about the application process is available on our prospective student - how to apply page as well as our FAQ page.
We are a growing program that is conducting cutting edge, interdisciplinary research to solve societal problems at the molecular level, and I encourage you to check out the research being conducted by our faculty. I hope you will consider joining us.
If you have questions about the application process or graduate programs that are not included on our website, please email me and I will be happy to assist you.
Good luck in your pursuit of graduate studies.
David Nutt Graduate Programs Coordinator Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry David.Nutt@asu.edu 480-965-4664
